levels.surface: عبد الله بن وهب بن زمعة

notes: Two taḥwīl branches that each write their own names (the second branch's teacher is «علي بن محمد»): separate groups, shared_tail null
«وهب بن عبد بن زمعة» and «عبد الله بن وهب بن زمعة» differ in the text itself; each is read as written
«قالت خرج أبو بكر في تجارة» : Umm Salama relays the story, and Abu Bakr and the others in it are scene characters

fixes.reason: HKG attaches عبد الله بن وهب بن زمعة to the first branch, which the text writes as وهب بن عبد بن زمعة.
